scientific_integrity: The maximal-removal matrix expectation is proved analytically for all parameters; finite exact and quadrature checks corroborate. Prior spherical-moment formulas may lead to an equivalent identity; no independence or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Rank-two positive semidefinite states and uniform directions on the range circle only; no higher-rank extension or full-algorithm convergence improvement is established.
title: Exact rank-two random-removal operator and sharp spectral-progress constant
